descriptor: AI meeting notes for small teams

voice.summary: Marginalia sounds like a good note-taker at the table: calm, precise and quietly editorial. It talks about decisions and actions, not artificial intelligence.
dos: Name outputs: decision, action item, owner
Keep promises about notes modest and specific
Use italic emphasis for the one word that matters
donts: Do not lean on AI jargon in headlines

taglines: Give your next meeting a memory
Hear every decision, keep every action
boilerplate: Marginalia is an AI meeting-notes tool for small teams that joins calls, writes clean notes live and pulls out every decision and action item before the meeting ends.

microcopy.error: Could not join that call. Check the link and try again.
microcopy.empty: No meetings yet. Paste a call link.

logo.note: A book is a nod to written margins and keeps the mark friendly for a notes product.
